notes: Use the confirmed default Fanqie release habit: three consecutive chapters at exactly 00:00 Asia/Shanghai each normal release day. A temporary extra release may contain any explicitly approved number of chapters, including one chapter. It consumes chapters early but does not reduce the original future day's three-chapter quota. After an early release, compact all remaining scheduled chapters forward in chapter-number order to refill each normal release day to three chapters at 00:00 where inventory permits. Never skip or reorder chapter numbers. Automatic mutation remains separately gated by config.json sync_enabled plus explicit audited authorization.
